title: JANUS Genesis Face Authority Epoch and Micro-Review — Runtime Execution Receipt

github_actions.workflow_name: JANUS face authority epoch and micro-review

verified_behaviors: capability lease is non-transferable across faces
revocation after host authorization but before dispatch blocks dispatch
authority epoch rotation invalidates stale leases
prepared dispatch permit is revalidated immediately before effect and can be invalidated by revocation
capability dispatch budget cannot be reused after exhaustion
high-risk/irreversible micro-review uses independent challenge assignments with authority_weight=0
a low-routing-priority face carrying novel counterevidence is not starved
v18.7.21 base microcontrol tests remain compatible

known_open_edge.name: AUTHORIZED_BUT_REVOKED_RECOVERY
known_open_edge.description: Revocation safely blocks dispatch, but explicit cancellation/recovery of a now-stale underlying authorization is not yet implemented.
